description: Turkish Air Force F-100C Super Sabre inaugurated as a monument on 20 July 2024 at the 1974 landing beach memorial park at Alsancak near Kyrenia, alongside the preserved landing ship. It is painted 41903 in the Turkish four-digit style; the full serial is 54-1903, construction number 217-164. Northern, Turkish Cypriot-administered Cyprus. Present on Esri imagery acquired 13 August 2025.

Turkish Army AB 205A licence-built Iroquois erected at the Alsancak 1974 landing beach memorial park about a year before the F-100, photographed in place in October 2023. Northern, Turkish Cypriot-administered Cyprus. OpenStreetMap carries a memorial node named Anit Helikopter at this position.
